screen: Competency › cm-taxonomy-framework (Libraries & Taxonomy, Skill Taxonomy, Taxonomy Ontology, Framework & Role Mapping Studio)
screenLevelGaps: CUSTOMER CLAIM PARTLY WRONG — 'no relationship between the tabs'. Three real relationships DO exist in code: (a) Job Role Task.jobrole is a strict dropdown fed from the Job Role tab (library-config.ts:255-264) and Task Management reads s_user_jobrole_task filtered by that exact name (services/task/index.ts:594-611); (b) the Skill tab's Job Role filter joins s_user_skill_jobrole (LibraryController.php:531-540); (c) the KASA detail popup resolves 'which skills reference this item' and 'which roles inherit it' through s_skill_knowledge_ability (LibraryController.php:1064-1092). The claim is CORRECT for creation: no create/edit form on any tab can write any of those links.

KASBA IS NOT LINKABLE FROM ANY FORM. The Knowledge/Ability/Attitude/Behaviour create forms expose only title, category, sub_category, description, assessment_method, business_link + free-text extras (library-config.ts:104-115; backend writable columns LibraryController.php:113-168). There is no skill_id, no jobrole_id, no proficiency_level field. The link table s_skill_knowledge_ability is written ONLY by the legacy Blade skillLibraryController::update (skillLibraryController.php:780-901) behind ['auth','session','menu'] (routes/web.php:104,113). No Next.js screen writes it. So a Knowledge item created here is permanently orphaned and its 'Knowledge Skills' panel will always read 'No skill references this Knowledge yet'.

THE KASA↔SKILL JOIN IS A STRING MATCH, NOT AN FK. usageKasa matches s_skill_knowledge_ability.classification_item against the KASA row's title verbatim (LibraryController.php:1067). Renaming a Knowledge item through the form silently detaches it from every skill that referenced it; there is no cascade and no warning.

ROLE→KASA MAPPING IS READ-ONLY IN THIS MODULE. s_library_map (knowledge_ids/ability_ids/attitude_ids/behaviour_ids per job role) is read by LibraryController::libraryMapAttributes (853-887) but written only by the Gemini JD analyser (Api/Gemini/SaveJDController.php:469-510). Nothing in Libraries & Taxonomy can attach KASA to a role.

THE ENTIRE SIDE DETAIL PANEL IS DEAD CODE. library-tab.tsx declares `selected` (line 206) but never calls setSelected(row) — the only calls are setSelected(null) at 400/413/422. openRow() sets richDetail instead (441-443). Therefore the <Sheet> at 1054-1073, the whole LibraryDetail component (library-detail.tsx, 366 lines), and the useLibraryDetail fetch (223-226) never render. The consequence: showJobrole's associations (tasks, mapped skills, s_library_map KASA — LibraryController.php:820-842) are computed by the backend and reachable by URL but displayed nowhere. The Job Role tab has NO detail view at all: cardsFor() gives jobrole/jobrole-task/invisible only a 'Details' card (library-detail-modal.tsx:108).

JOB ROLES CREATED HERE ARE INVISIBLE TO HRIT. The Job Role form writes `department` as a free-text/OpenChoice string (library-config.ts:214) and never sets department_id, even though the backend accepts it (LibraryController.php:81). HRIT's own job-role API joins s_user_jobrole.department_id → hrms_departments.id (JobroleApiController.php:27-28,40-42), so a role added from Competency has NULL department_id and never appears in HRIT's department-filtered role list. Same for the Skill tab's `department`. Organization/HRIT is supposed to be the source of truth for department; here department is re-derived from DISTINCT strings on s_users_skills and s_user_jobrole (LibraryController.php:1749-1778) — a parallel, drifting vocabulary.

A JOB ROLE WITH A BLANK DEPARTMENT IS UNUSABLE. buildMeta skips any role whose department is empty when building jobroles_by_department (LibraryController.php:1738-1741). That map is the ONLY source for the Job Role filter (library-tab.tsx:275-288) and for the Job Role Task form's mandatory Job Role dropdown (library-form.tsx:124-129). So a department-less role can never have a task filed against it and can never be filtered on.

cm-skill-taxonomy IS NOT REDUNDANT WITH LIBRARIES & TAXONOMY, BUT IT IS 80% REDUNDANT WITH THE SKILL TAB'S TAXONOMY DRAWER. It is strictly read-only (no create/edit/delete anywhere in the 321-line file) and renders category→sub-category→skill from GET /competency/library/skill-taxonomy-tree (LibraryController.php:1508-1578). TaxonomyManager already shows category→sub-category with per-node counts AND can rename/add/delete (taxonomy-manager.tsx). What cm-skill-taxonomy uniquely adds: the leaf level (individual skill names with department, L{n} and approve_status chips), a department filter on the tree, and Expand/Collapse All. WHAT WOULD BREAK IF DELETED: menu entry submenuId '41' / accessLink /module/competency-management/competency-library/skill-taxonomy (content-map-m2.ts:27) would 404; the endpoint GET /competency/library/skill-taxonomy-tree and hook useSkillTaxonomy would become orphans (grep shows cm-skill-taxonomy is their only caller). Nothing else references it. Recommendation: fold the leaf list + department filter into the Skill tab's Taxonomy drawer and retire the screen.

TAXONOMY ONTOLOGY IS AN IFRAME TO A THIRD-PARTY VERCEL APP, AND A FIRST-PARTY GRAPH API ALREADY EXISTS AND IS UNUSED. cm-taxonomy-ontology.tsx:28 hardcodes https://skill-ontology-neo4j.vercel.app and passes sub_institute_id in the query string (line 51). Meanwhile this repo already ships JobRoleGraphController (GET /api/jobroles/{id}/graph) whose Cypher models exactly the right ontology — (JobRole)-[:REQUIRES_SKILL]->(Skill)-[:REQUIRES_BEHAVIOUR]->(Behaviour), plus REQUIRES_KNOWLEDGE/ABILITY/ATTITUDE (JobRoleGraphController.php:22-32) — and DepartmentGraphController. No frontend file calls either. Worse, the only sync writer, Neo4jSyncController.php:26-56, MERGEs Organization→Departments→JobRoles only; it never writes Skill/Knowledge/Ability/Attitude/Behaviour nodes, so even the first-party graph is a three-level org chart, not a competency ontology.

WHAT THE ONTOLOGY SHOULD BE: the single reconciliation layer over the five libraries — JobRole -REQUIRES_SKILL{required_level}-> Skill; Skill -DECOMPOSES_INTO{level}-> Knowledge|Ability|Attitude|Behaviour; JobRole -PERFORMS-> JobRoleTask -DEMANDS-> Skill; Skill -TAUGHT_BY-> Course (LMS); Employee -HOLDS{actual_level}-> Skill (s_skill_matrix). That graph is what makes 'orphaned competency', 'role that shares 80% of another role's skills', and 'gap → course' answerable. Today it answers none of them because nothing populates it and it is a foreign iframe.

FRAMEWORKS ARE EMPTY SHELLS. s_competency_framework_items (competency_id → required_proficiency) has a full CRUD API — GET/POST /competency/frameworks/{id}/items, DELETE .../items/{itemId} (routes/api.php:440-442, FrameworkController.php:322-453) — and the frontend even declares addFrameworkItem/removeFrameworkItem/getFramework (studio.ts:300,330,337). Grep over the whole g2gv0 tree shows ZERO callers. No screen can put a competency into a framework. The 'Framework Structure' tab does not show the framework's contents; it shows a category tree of ALL approved s_users_skills (StudioController.php:280-347) that is identical no matter which framework is active.

THE FRAMEWORK IS DISCONNECTED FROM THE MATRIX IT SITS NEXT TO. Matrix cells are written to s_user_skill_jobrole (RoleMappingController.php:202-236) with no framework_id column involved. So switching the active framework changes nothing in the matrix, the weighting, or the proficiency scale. 'Active Framework' is a label with a status, not a container.

EDITING A FRAMEWORK SILENTLY WIPES ITS DEPARTMENT. FrameworkController::update unconditionally writes 'department_id' => $request->input('department_id') (FrameworkController.php:218). The Edit Framework dialog never renders or sends department_id (cm-framework-mapping.tsx:1004-1034) and openFrameworkDialog does not seed it (238). Any save through this dialog nulls department_id on an existing framework.

THE MATRIX CAN ONLY EVER SEE 6 JOB ROLES, AND ONLY ROLES THAT ARE ALREADY MAPPED. use-competency-studio.ts:124 requests getRoles({ per_page: 6 }); nothing paginates it. That 6-row array is the entire universe for the 'All Roles' quick filter, the Filters multi-select and the Bulk Update role dropdown. Worse, RoleMappingController::roles derives roles by GROUP BY on s_user_skill_jobrole (lines 42-61) — a job role with zero mappings never appears, so a newly created role can never be mapped from this screen. Chicken-and-egg with no escape hatch.

MATRIX ROWS ARE SILENTLY CAPPED AT 300 COMPETENCIES (RoleMappingController.php:123 ->limit(300)). No 'truncated' flag is returned and the UI shows no warning, unlike the skill taxonomy tree which does warn at 5,000.

CSV IMPORT CAN MANUFACTURE ORPHAN MAPPINGS. importMatrix (cm-framework-mapping.tsx:319-344) posts every header cell straight to saveCell with no validation, and upsertCell accepts any free string as `skill` (RoleMappingController.php:196, resolveSkillTitle 351-365) and any string as `jobrole`. A typo'd column header or row label inserts a s_user_skill_jobrole row for a role/skill that does not exist, which then inflates coverage_percent and 'Job Roles Mapped'.

THE APPROVAL GATE ON MAPPINGS IS THEATRE. Cells are written the instant a level is picked (handleSetCell → saveCell → PUT /role-mapping/cell). 'Submit for Review' merely inserts a row in s_competency_mapping_reviews, and approve/reject only flips that row's status (MappingReviewController.php:146-198) — it applies nothing and reverts nothing. Also, only effectiveRoles[0] is ever submitted (cm-framework-mapping.tsx:355), so a multi-role editing session produces a single-role review card.

THE FRAMEWORK APPROVAL GATE IS BYPASSABLE FROM THE SAME DIALOG THAT ENFORCES IT. The 'Submit for publish' paper-plane routes drafts through s_competency_approvals correctly (ApprovalController.php:195-272, 280-345), but the Create/Edit Framework dialog's Status dropdown offers 'Active (published)' directly (cm-framework-mapping.tsx:1020-1026) and FrameworkController::store/update accept it (in:draft,active,archived — lines 67, 199). Anyone with create rights can self-publish.

WEIGHTING IS TENANT-GLOBAL, NOT PER FRAMEWORK, DESPITE LIVING INSIDE THE FRAMEWORK STUDIO. saveWeights posts to /competency/studio/weights, which writes s_competency_framework_weights with framework_id = NULL (StudioController.php:676-685). The per-framework endpoints GET/PUT /competency/frameworks/{id}/weights (routes/api.php:443-444, FrameworkController.php:458-587) exist and have zero frontend callers. Two frameworks cannot weight the same category differently.

THE SCORING RULES BEHIND THE WEIGHTS ARE UNREACHABLE. /competency/studio/weighting-config (GET+PUT) exposes scoring_model, rounding, target_threshold, unmapped_handling and apply_to with full option metadata (StudioController.php:35-168, routes/api.php:433-434). Grep over g2gv0 finds no caller and no service method. The tab is literally named 'Weighting & Configuration' but only the weights half exists; weights sum to a number that no visible surface says how to apply. Total% is validated visually against 100 but nothing prevents saving 340%.

THE WEIGHTS THEMSELVES FEED NOTHING VISIBLE. s_competency_framework_weights is read back only by these same two endpoints; no assessment, gap-analysis or readiness calculation in the Competency module consumes it. Per the ownership model it should drive competency scoring in Assessments, gap severity, and role-readiness % in Talent Management.

'CREATE FRAMEWORK' HAS 4 FIELDS. Present: Framework Name (text), Version (free text, no semver validation), Status (draft/active/archived), Description (textarea). Absent, and needed by any real competency framework: owning Department (backend column department_id exists and is accepted, no field); applicable Job Role / Job Family (backend column jobrole exists and is accepted, no field — only preserved on edit, never settable); Framework Type (core / functional / leadership / technical — the customer spec's own 'Competency weighting (core vs. functional vs. leadership)'); Proficiency Scale binding (which scale this framework rates against — today there is exactly one tenant-global scale); Effective From / Review Due dates; Framework Owner / Steward (created_by is stamped but never shown or editable); Industry / Regulatory basis (NOS/SFIA/O*NET reference); Parent framework / supersedes (for versioning — 'Clone' produces v1.0 every time, FrameworkController.php:274, so version history is a name suffix); Competency inclusion list with required proficiency per competency (the items API that is never called); Category weighting scoped to this framework; Approval chain / reviewers.

THE COMPETENCY DETAIL DRAWER SHOWS THE WRONG BEHAVIOURAL INDICATORS. cm-framework-mapping.tsx:803 reads proficiency?.kasa.behaviour.find(k => k.level === 4)?.indicators — the tenant-global level-4 behaviour descriptor. It is identical under every competency and hardcoded to level 4, yet is labelled 'Behavioural Indicators (Level 4)' inside a competency-specific panel.

THE SKILL TAB AND cm-competency-library BOTH WRITE s_users_skills THROUGH DIFFERENT ENDPOINTS. Skill tab → PUT /competency/library/skills/{id} (LibraryController). Competency Library → PUT /skill_library/competency/{id} (skillLibraryController). Different writable column sets, different validation, different duplicate rules. The mitigation (send only changed fields, library-form.tsx:312) reduces but does not remove the blast radius. THIS is the real redundancy, not cm-skill-taxonomy.

THE FILE'S OWN DOCBLOCK IS WRONG. cm-libraries-taxonomy.tsx:20-24 states 'Skills/competencies are deliberately NOT a tab here.' LIBRARY_TABS[0] is SKILL_LIBRARY_CONFIG (library-config.ts:191), so Skill is the first tab. Default landing tab is 'jobrole' (cm-libraries-taxonomy.tsx:27), which is why it can look absent.

NO CROSS-TAB NAVIGATION ANYWHERE. From a Knowledge item you cannot jump to a referencing Skill; from a Skill you cannot jump to its Job Role's task list; from a Job Role you cannot reach its tasks (that view is dead). The detail popup renders names as plain text with no links (library-detail-modal.tsx:540, 601). Every relationship the data supports is a read-only leaf.

NO BULK IMPORT ON ANY LIBRARY TAB. Export exists on all eight (library-tab.tsx:596-604); the customer spec asks for 'Bulk import/export (Excel/CSV) for competencies, job profiles, employee mappings'. Only the framework matrix has an import, and it is unvalidated.

NOTHING ON THESE FOUR SCREENS FEEDS LMS OR TALENT. The one LMS touchpoint is Build Course (library-detail-modal.tsx:248-256), which calls /lms/ai/* to draft an outline and render Gamma slides but never persists a course row, never links the generated deck back to the competency, and never creates an lms_course record. There is no 'required proficiency → learning path' handoff and no 'framework → role readiness %' handoff to Talent Management.
